meeting_point: Boston Harbor Island Welcome Center on the Rose Kennedy Greenway at 191w Atlantic Avenue, Boston, MA 02110
pricing:
$40 Adults(12 years and older)
$35 Students/military(Must present ID at check-in)
$35 Seniors(For ages 65 and older)
$30 kids(4 - 11 years old)
$ 0.00 Toddlers (0-3 years old)
description: Experience the lighthouses of Boston Harbor Islands National and State Park through a special narrated cruise. Join us as we voyage through maritime history and pass renowned Boston Harbor landmarks on this three-lighthouse tour.
itinerary: This 2-hour cruise will sail past Long Island Light, Graves Light, and Boston Light, America's oldest light station. Narrations and programs on-board provided by staff and volunteers from the National Park Service and United States Coast Guard. ​
what_to_bring: There is no food or water available on the boat. Feel free to bring your own snacks and meals.
special_requirements:
- There is no public access to Little Brewster or Boston Light.
- Adverse weather conditions can force cancellations. Please check your email and voicemail before your trip. ​
- Alcohol, smoking and vaping are prohibited on the boat.
